_comment: Read-only overview reports for u_toronto_event. Created by create_reports.py via POST sys_report. Filters use the SAME relative-date functions the UI condition builder writes (gs.endOfCurrentMinute for 'after Current minute', gs.beginningOfThisWeek for 'This week'), plus the ^EQ terminator the builder appends, so these render as friendly picker labels rather than raw text.

reports.title: Toronto Events — This Week
reports.description: Count of events starting in the current calendar week. Relative filter — updates itself every Monday.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Upcoming
reports.description: Everything whose start is still in the future.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Next 7 Days
reports.description: Rolling seven-day forward window. Better than 'this week' for planning because it does not reset to zero each Monday.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Free vs Paid
reports.description: Split of free and ticketed events among those with a start date.

reports.title: Toronto Events — By Source
reports.description: Which feed or scraper contributed how many events. Useful for spotting a source that silently stopped.

reports.title: Toronto Events — By Status
reports.description: Distribution of status values (UPCOMING today). Will show cancellations the moment the feed carries them.

reports.title: Toronto Events — By Duration Category
reports.description: Single-day versus multi-day split.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Multi-Day
reports.description: Events spanning more than one day.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Upcoming By Source
reports.description: Forward-looking version of By Source — who is supplying the events that are actually still ahead of us.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Added This Week
reports.description: How many records the nightly sync inserted this week. Distinguishes 'the feed grew' from 'the feed did not change'.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Data Quality: No Coordinates
reports.description: 2,341 of 11,940 at first load were missing lat/lng. Track it as a quality metric rather than discovering it when a map report looks empty.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Data Quality: No Start Date
reports.description: Events that cannot appear in any date-based view. Should stay near zero.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Today
reports.description: Events starting today. Resets at midnight.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Tomorrow
reports.description: Events starting tomorrow.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Next 30 Days
reports.description: Forward pipeline for the month.

reports.title: Toronto Events — By Venue
reports.description: Which venues host the most upcoming events. A stand-in for the map until the geo layer is finished.

reports.title: Toronto Events — By Category
reports.description: First category of each event (11 clean buckets). The full CSV stays in u_categories for search.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Newly Added
reports.description: How many records the sync has been adding over the last two weeks.

reports.title: Toronto Events — Still To Come Today
reports.description: Only events that have not started yet today. Counts down to zero as the day runs out.

reports.title: Toronto Events — All Upcoming
reports.description: Everything still ahead, no upper bound.
